research_claim: Task-support development check only; no compression or new method claim.
engineering_cases: First three fixed cases, both conditions; whole native generate, cached native generate, custom cached greedy must have identical token IDs.

decoding.native_chat_template: Pinned tokenizer_config default, no override of enable_thinking; entire task is one user message as released action profile.

gate.on_failure: Stop this dataset/design; retain all errors, full wrong cases, class metrics and paired transitions. No prompt/model/seed/length search or compression.

notes: NoHistory is a task-support contrast that changes text length and positions; it is not KV eviction.
All 32 fixed cases remain in the main analysis; no future full-correct-only test-set selection.
Native lenient parser compatibility and strict unique Judgment are reported separately; invalid outputs are errors, never silently safe.
Whole four-tag schema adherence is diagnostic; the preregistered gate requires a unique complete Judgment for all Full cases.
No actual agent actions or recorded tools are executed.
